LESSON: TIME (DAILY ROUTINE)

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / PP2
Subject: General
Strand: Measurement
Topic 3.4: Time (Daily routine)
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 8

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Time (Daily routine), part of Measurement in SNE  /  physical-impairment / PP2 General.

Key inquiry question: How do we tell time every day?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. Talk about in purposive pairs/groups, tools used to tell time such as clock, calendar, watches. Learners with speech difficulties could use Alternative and Augmentative modes of Communication (AAC) to express their views.

2. Talk about in purposive pairs/groups vocabulary related to time and daily activities done at different times of the day.

3. Compare sizes of shadows at different times of the day. Create a conducive environment and adequate for learners such as those using mobility devices as they compare sizes of shadows. Ensure safety standards are upheld for all learners.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. Talk about in purposive pairs/groups, tools used to tell time such as clock, calendar, watches. Learners with speech difficulties could use Alternative and Augmentative modes of Communication (AAC) to express their views.
2. Talk about in purposive pairs/groups vocabulary related to time and daily activities done at different times of the day.
3. Compare sizes of shadows at different times of the day. Create a conducive environment and adequate for learners such as those using mobility devices as they compare sizes of shadows. Ensure safety standards are upheld for all learners.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Time (Daily routine) together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Citizenship: learners learn to be responsible, ethical and socially connected individuals as they work with one another.

Values:
Love: learners share flashcards on days of the week and months of the year while arranging while arranging them in sequence.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Social cohesion: learners work harmoniously with one another to arrange flashcards on days of the week and months of the

year in sequence.

Link to Other Activity Areas:

The learner is able to relate arranging flashcards on days of the week and months of the year in sequence to pre-reading skills

of arranging pictures on daily routine in Language Activities.
